allow.reason: Cairn's header shows at most --width-header-name (128px) of the member's name, ending it with an ellipsis, so the header keeps one line on a phone; the whole name is the menu button's accessible name and is written out in the open menu ("Signed in as …"). Kept by the design-method pass: showing the whole name means wrapping the header onto more lines or moving the name into the menu, which changes the App header's look and removes a token, and that pass keeps Cairn's look and tokens as they are. To fix: a header change of its own that moves the name into the menu and drops the token.

allow.selector: div.styleguide-frame:nth-of-type(3) > header.shell__header > div.shell__inner.app-header__inner > details.app-header__menu > summary.app-header__summary > span.app-header__name
